nom: VANICREAM Gentle Facial Cleanser for Sensitive Skin

segments.oily: One reviewer with acne-prone/oily-leaning combination skin says it cleanses without over-drying, and another notes it works less well for oily skin, sometimes causing breakouts, than for dry skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or very dry skin describe it as hydrating and non-stripping, though a few with dry/combination skin report it left them with extreme dryness and flaking.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including some rosacea-prone or acne-prone, generally say it cleanses without stripping, but one describes it as very stripping and drying on combination skin.
segments.sensitive: The large majority of sensitive-skin reviewers, including those with rosacea, eczema, dermatitis and PCOS, report no irritation and calmer, less red skin, while a minority describe burning, redness, itching or dryness on first use.
segments.mature: Two reviewers describe it as good for aging or mature skin, citing gentle cleansing without dryness and a pleasant lathering texture.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal-to-dry sensitive skin says it cleanses thoroughly without stripping.

concerns.aging: A couple of reviewers with mature/aging skin say the cleanser is gentle and hydrating with no negative effect noted on aging skin specifically.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it does not strip moisture and even helps rebuild the skin barrier, but several explicitly report it left their skin dry, tight, or flaky, especially in winter or on already dehydrated skin.
concerns.redness: Many reviewers with rosacea or general redness report visible calming and reduced redness over days to weeks; a smaller group reports the opposite, with painful burning, increased redness or swelling after use.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers credit the cleanser with helping rebuild or protect a damaged skin barrier; one reports it stripped and worsened her barrier instead.
concerns.spots: Multiple acne-prone reviewers report fewer breakouts and clearer skin over weeks; a few report new painful cystic or itchy breakouts, with one blaming a specific ingredient (mica).
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers describe reduced breakouts and clearer, smoother skin with regular use; a few describe the opposite, with sudden painful pimples appearing after starting the product.
concerns.oiliness: A couple of reviewers with oily or acne-prone-oily skin say it cleanses without leaving residue or making skin overly oily; one long-term user notes it may not suit oilier or combination skin as well as dry skin.

extraits.texte: i have extremely sensitive combination skin, i was very excited to try this product as ive only heard good reviews. this cleanser stripped my skin and left me with EXTREME dry, flaky patches all over my face. i have never had this issue with a cleanser, especially marketed at gentle. will be going back to la roche posay

My dermatologist recommended this cleanser as my skin is very sensitive and the ingredient list is super simple/minimal. Was nice for a while, but eventually I noticed that my cheeks and other parts of my face were getting super dry. I have combination, rosacea prone, sensitive skin for reference. I had stopped using the cleanser to see if that was what was causing the issues with dry skin/stripped skin barrier. Soon found out that the cleanser was the cause! Which was very disappointing, especially with how basic the ingredient list is. I had to stop using the cleanser immediately and switched to a different one, which thankfully hydrated my skin and helped repair my barrier over time. I will never use this cleanser again nor recommend it to my friends or family. Very disappointed that this cleanser did this to my face.

I was diagnosed with Rosacea a few months ago. Before my diagnosis, I had tried tirelessly to find skincare products that would help clear up my red, itchy, burning, and dry patchy skin. NOTHING worked. It seemed as if everything I tried only itritated my skin more. If I spent 10 dollars or close to 100 dollars, it was all for nothing. I finally saw a derm who gave me a prescription for a cream that was suppose to help and clear up the redness and "demodex" but that cream burned like the dickens!!! After doing a ton of research, I came across this cleanser and thought, "well I've tried everything else, including my prescription cream, what do I have to lose?" Let me tell you…this cleanser has changed my life!!!!! After only a few days of using it, along with the moisturizer, my skin had cleared up almost completey!!!! My face has not looked this good in 2 years!!!! I have been using this in combination with the moisturizer every night and every morning for a little over a month now, and my results have been AMAZING!!! Everyone's skin is different, and everyone's skin issues are different, so definitely seek treatment by a derm FIRST, but if all else fails, give this a try!!

I'm in my mid to late twenties and I have dry combo, sensitive, acne prone skin and I'm on prescription retinol from my derm making the dry and sensitive parts worse. I recently discovered vanicream in an attenpt to keep my skincare routine simple, affordable, and sensitive skin friendly. I don't like the heavy feeling of cream cleansers and most gel cleansers are drying. This cleanser is gentle and leaves my skin feeling clean, and free of residue from my cleansing balm or the previous night's skincare. I can use it twice a day without drying my skin out. I love this cleanser and truly feel that it would work for all skin types.

I switched to this cleanser about 2 months ago, ever since then my skin has never been softer. I have acne prone oily skin and this does not irritate my breakouts. It is kind of hard to explain how this works because it gently cleanses my skin yet removes leftover make up. My skin feel so soft after using this, but it doesn't leave a film on my face, yet it doesn't make me face feel tight and stripped of moisture. I would highly recommend giving this a try. My only cons are that it smells like chemicals and I can not find a bigger size to buy.

I used to use neutrogena gentle cleanser but when i ran out, i bought vanicream and i love it and forever my staple item. I buy other cleansers - mind you - pricer cleansers like Dieux but i keep going back to Vanicream. I feel like genuinely clean but not stripped like at all. I love its non comodogenic and its literally so simple ingredient wise - my skin is prone to redness and it calms my redness down, It is genuinely made for dry skin so i do understand why other customers with combo & oily skin may break out. I feel like i got maybe less acne for my skin with this cleanser but i also just get occasional pimples, and its also good as a second cleanser for wearing make up. If youre just looking for a simple cleanser, get this! Their other products are good too

I used to have oily skin, but now that I'm older I have dry sensitive skin. Every cleanser I used was either too harsh now, too drying, wouldn't remove all my makeup or would cause breakouts. I tried this and it helped; I'm not using any other cleansers now. I love it!
